open_findings.title: Calendar-year comparison counts the wrong preceding calendar range
open_findings.reproduction: Select 2024 (Jan 1 2024 through Jan 1 2025) with imported plays at Dec 31 2022 noon and Jan 1 2023 noon. periodProfile previous counts both because it subtracts 366 days; UI labels the result im Jahr 2023.
open_findings.expected: Comparison labelled 2023 counts only Jan 1 2023 through Jan 1 2024, or label explicitly says equal-length preceding window rather than calendar year.
open_findings.actual: previous.plays=2 instead of 1; 2022 event contaminates 2023 comparison. 2025 vs leap-year2024 conversely omits Jan1 2024.
open_findings.impact: False annual listening metrics and changes.
open_findings.repair: Carry an explicit prior calendar interval for year choices or make the current equal-span label accurate; preserve custom/rolling semantics.

open_findings.title: Session highlight claims uninterrupted listening across known pauses
open_findings.reproduction: Two exact imported plays of 30 minutes end at Jan1 2024 12:00 and12:39 UTC. Second starts12:09: known9-minute silence. periodProfile returns longestSession60min; actual ProfileScreen displays 1 Stunden ohne Pause.
open_findings.expected: Describe a session allowing gaps of up to10min, or compute genuinely uninterrupted duration; exact listening minutes alone do not prove continuous playback. Live estimates must also be qualified.
open_findings.actual: 60-minute session with known9-minute pause labelled ohne Pause.
open_findings.impact: Trust contract: claimed listening evidence exceeds known timeline.
open_findings.repair: Use truthful qualified session label and definition, without changing playback state or inventing continuous listening.

open_findings.title: Most-heard artist label disagrees with displayed play-count ranking
open_findings.reproduction: Mixed/live period: Long has1 play30 estimated minutes, Frequent10 plays totaling10 estimated minutes. minutesExactfalse. topArtists ranks Long first by estimated time; rendered bars show Long1× first and Frequent10× second, and calls Long most-heard with9% share.
open_findings.expected: State explicitly that ranking uses estimated listening time, or rank consistently by displayed plays; do not imply first has most plays.
open_findings.actual: Confirmed in real browser and core attack.
open_findings.repair: Align ranking, displayed units and most-heard claim.
